text:
ITEM 1 | Bowl is a stainless steel mixing bowl about 20-22 cm across; contents fill roughly 70% of its area. Cubed pieces, about 1.5-2 cm, off-white to pale tan with slightly rough, matte, porous surface and firm edges, sitting in a heap at the left and center of the bowl | 280
ITEM 2 | Thin, irregular flat shards, pale cream-yellow, slightly translucent edges, dry-looking matte surface with some fine grain, scattered across the right side of the bowl, about 3-5 cm long and 0.3 cm thick, lying over the cubed pieces | 120
ITEM 3 | Smooth, glossy, light brown semi-viscous paste with slight sheen, spread in a mound about 8 cm across at the center of the bowl, partially pooling and holding a soft peaked shape, sitting on top of cubed pieces and shards | 90
ITEM 4 | Thin rings and half-rings of pale purple-white onion, translucent edges, about 0.2 cm thick, scattered among the other ingredients near the top and bottom of the bowl, moist surface | 25
ITEM 5 | Small diced pieces of orange carrot, about 0.5 cm, bright matte surface, scattered sparsely among the cubes and onion near the bottom and top edges | 15
ITEM 6 | Small diced pieces of red pepper, about 0.5-1 cm, glossy deep red skin, scattered in the lower-left area beneath the cubed pieces | 10
